The paired complementary increments cancel modulo 100. After their last direct assignments, the increments to \(a\) and \(b\) each sum to 0 modulo 100, so they remain 29 and 8. For TMP, the uncancelled increments total \(99+57+31+14+26+40=267\); including its initial value gives \(94+267\equiv61\pmod{100}\).

ANSWER: a ?= 29; b ?= 8; TMP ?= 61;
